analysis: Examined base_text lines 1-630 of provider-swift/Tests/ClusterPlacementChecks/PlacementSetupCheck.swift. The only change in this file, per a complete range map, is at base 1260-1262 / head 1260-1264. That change is outside the supplied units and visible only in the patch excerpt. It updates a test assertion so that ClusterPairServingGrants.publicTrafficLine takes a new publicModels: [] argument. The assertion still expects that a family with no passing record is notYetQualified, and that the phase split is still 'qualified for public traffic'. This is test-only code, so it adds no runtime attack surface. The supplied units cover the guided placement flow, the hand-off opt-in, debug-only forced-mode and bench-cap overrides that a release build refuses, served-speed build scoping, and qualification records. None of these are changed in this PR. The new publicModels parameter suggests that production code changed elsewhere, possibly letting a 'public declaration' affect public-traffic qualification. That could touch the serving-authorization and qualification contracts (A-017, TB-011, T-052, T-054), but the production implementation is not in this batch. Integration should check that publicModels cannot grant public traffic without passing qualification records, and should check what the test does with a non-empty publicModels. No regression was identified in the supplied evidence.
